method: Independent native review. 2,389 frames decoded by the parent frame-review session (exact-PTS select with showinfo proof, BelowNormal, 4 threads, streamed, obs64/Marvel absent and free RAM >= 2 GB before every window): all 178 owner review frames (hash- and own_hud-equal), every 30th frame across the 13 accepts, every 6th frame through 2 s at each accepted edge plus the frames just outside, dense frames around both VK52 presses and the reader misses f7307/f44383/f49097. Inputs replayed inside every accept: bound mouse 1/2/4 only; no button 3, T, UI key, scroll or focus change. Inspected visually as contact sheets (1 s bulk, 0.1 s edges, dense unbound-key and reader-miss windows, all owner frames of rejected segments).
findings: VK52 ('4') at 257.105 s and 312.599 s: no menu, overlay or camera change on frames; still unidentified (also pressed in -5 and -7).
Own-HUD reader failures inside accepts are reader misses on his own play (combat effects, bonus health, low-hp overlay, a sky-facing camera at 310.70 s); no spectate, kill cam or cinematic.
Several rejects are conservative rule cuts over own play (e.g. seg-003, seg-004, seg-007, seg-011, seg-040, seg-041, seg-044, seg-045); this only loses data.
